template_data.headline_html: Four assumptions that quietly kill your GSA margins.

items.title: Commercial rates = safe baseline
items.desc: The Price Reduction Clause ties your GSA price to every future commercial discount. Your market rate becomes a ceiling, not a floor.

items.title: Price low, win fast
items.desc: Post-award mods to raise pricing are slow and often denied. Lock in a margin you can actually operate at.

items.title: BOA details can wait
items.desc: Undefined Basis of Award triggers unpredictable price reductions — usually surfacing 12–18 months after award.

items.title: No escalation clause needed
items.desc: Five-year contracts. No EPA. Your 2026 margins are your 2031 margins — minus inflation.
